cardOverview.overviewText: A Shaurya Select card designed for defense personnel, providing elevated lifestyle rewards, milestone shopping and travel benefits, comprehensive insurance coverage, and fee waivers, crafted to honor and support armed forces members.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary insurance cover worth 10 lakhs against personal accident.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, immediately report the incident to SBI Customer Care at 1800 1234, 1800 2100, or 1800 112211. For email support, contact customercare@sbi.co.in
